# AI Heroes

> AI Heroes B.V. (Groningen, the Netherlands, KvK 42051968) builds software and AI for organisations that want more than a pilot. We design, build and implement, and make sure it works: with a solid business case, compliance from the drawing board and a team that can run it. Three ways in: build something new, replace software that no longer fits, or run AI on your own servers or European hosting. The first step is always the start sprint: one week, fixed fee from EUR 8,000, ending in a working prototype or a build plan, always with the business case. Office: Aarhusweg 4-16, 9723 JJ Groningen. Contact: hello@aiheroes.io.

AI Heroes bouwt software en AI voor organisaties die verder willen dan een pilot. Wij ontwerpen, bouwen en implementeren, en zorgen dat het werkt: met een sluitende business case, compliance vanaf de tekentafel en een team dat ermee overweg kan. Van ambitie naar implementatie. Vanuit Groningen, voor heel Europa.

## The AI Heroes standard (included in every build)

- Business case first: cost, return and payback on one page, before we build
- Compliance from the drawing board: AI Act classification, logging, human oversight, European hosting
- Your people trained on it: the team that will use the system is trained on that system (meets Article 4 of the EU AI Act)
- Handover without lock-in: source code, documentation and data model are yours

## Start here (English)

- [The start sprint](https://aiheroes.io/en/start-sprint): one week, fixed fee from EUR 8,000, working prototype or build plan plus business case
- [What we build](https://aiheroes.io/en/services): the three entries
- [Build something new](https://aiheroes.io/en/services/software): assistants, workflows, voice AI, internal tools, customer portals; custom builds from EUR 15,000
- [Replace what no longer fits](https://aiheroes.io/en/services/replace-software): outdated custom systems and overpriced SaaS replaced by software that fits, connected to ERP, CRM and the rest of the landscape
- [Run it on your own terms](https://aiheroes.io/en/services/eu-consultancy): local models, European cloud, no US cloud dependency, AI Act built in
- [How we work](https://aiheroes.io/en/about/approach): the start sprint, the AI Heroes standard, business case, compliance, training, handover
- [Business case and scoping](https://aiheroes.io/en/services/consulting): a phase of every build; standalone advisory work also possible
- [Training your team](https://aiheroes.io/en/services/training): part of every build; standalone in-company training from EUR 2,500 per day
- [AI literacy training](https://aiheroes.io/en/services/ai-literacy-training): Article 4 of the EU AI Act, with certificate
